description: This file defines React hooks and utility functions for progressive batch processing in the UI. It includes a non-React utility function 'createProgressiveExpandController' to process items in batches with idle callbacks or fallbacks, and a React hook 'useProgressiveExpand' to manage UI state during such processing.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object to process items in batches asynchronously, supporting progress callbacks, cancellation, and fallback scheduling.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: React hook that manages UI state for progressive batch processing, wrapping around createProgressiveExpandController and providing start/cancel controls along with progress tracking.
